lat: weddert s-swaret dyali f sh-shari3
en: I lost my keys in the street.

lat: ma weddertsh l-beztam dyali l-bare7
en: I did not lose my wallet yesterday.

lat: wedderti t-tilifun dyalek f t-tobis
en: You (m.) lost your phone on the bus.

lat: ma weddertish l-wraq dyal l-khedma
en: You (m.) didn't lose the work papers.

lat: wedderti n-ndader dyalek f l-qehwa
en: You (f.) lost your glasses in the cafe.

lat: ma weddertish l-khatem dyal d-dheb
en: You (f.) didn't lose the gold ring.

lat: wedder l-flus dyalu f s-suq
en: He lost his money in the market.

lat: ma weddersh t-triq l l-m7etta
en: He didn't lose the way to the station.

lat: weddrat s-sak dyalha f t-tren
en: She lost her bag on the train.

lat: ma weddratsh l-kart dyal l-banka
en: She did not lose the bank card.

lat: wedderna l-weqt bzzaf f z-zenqa
en: We lost a lot of time in the street.

lat: ma weddernash l-valiza dyalna f l-matar
en: We didn't lose our suitcase at the airport.

lat: weddertu s-swaret dyal d-dar l-bare7
en: You (pl.) lost the house keys yesterday.

lat: ma weddertush l-wraq dyalkum
en: You (pl.) did not lose your papers.

lat: weddru l-kora dyalhum f l-ghaba
en: They lost their ball in the forest.

lat: ma weddrush l-beztam dyalhum f t-taksi
en: They didn't lose their wallet in the taxi.

lat: dima kanwedder s-swaret f d-dar
en: I always lose the keys at home.

lat: ana ma kanweddersh l-flus dyali dima
ar: أنا ما كنوضرش الفلوس ديالي ديما
en: I don't always lose my money.

lat: katwedder n-ndader dyalek dima f l-khedma
en: You (m.) always lose your glasses at work.

lat: ma katweddersh l-weqt m3a s7abek
en: You (m.) do not waste time with your friends.

lat: dima katweddri l-beztam dyalek f s-sak
en: You (f.) always misplace your wallet in the bag.

lat: nti ma katweddrish l-wraq dyal l-mdrasa
ar: نتي ما كتوضريش الوراق ديال المدرسة
en: You (f.) don't lose school papers.

lat: huwa kaywedder s-swaret dyal t-tumubil dima
ar: هو كيوضر السوارت ديال الطوموبيل ديما
en: He always loses the car keys.

lat: huwa ma kayweddersh t-triq f l-mdina
en: He doesn't lose his way in the city.

lat: hiya katwedder t-tilifun dyalha f d-dar
en: She loses her phone at home.

lat: hiya ma katweddersh l-flus dyal l-khedma
ar: هي ما كتوضرش الفلوس ديال الخدمة
en: She does not lose the work money.

lat: kanweddru l-weqt f had l-blasa
en: We lose time in this place.

lat: 7na ma kanweddrush l-aghrad dyalna dima
ar: حنا ما كنوضروش الأغراض ديالنا ديما
en: We don't always lose our belongings.

lat: ntuma katweddru s-swaret kul simana
en: You (pl.) lose the keys every week.

lat: ntuma ma katweddrush l-wraq dyal s-sfer
ar: نتوما ما كتوضروش الوراق ديال السفر
en: You (pl.) don't lose travel documents.

lat: huma kayweddru l-flus f l-qmar
en: They lose money in gambling.

lat: huma ma kayweddrush t-triq l d-dar
en: They don't lose the way home.

lat: ghadi nwedder t-triq ila mshit bu7di
ar: غادي نوضر الطريق إيلا مشيت بوحدي
en: I will lose the way if I go alone.

lat: ma ghadish nwedder l-wraq dyalek ghedda
ar: ما غاديش نوضر الوراق ديالك غدا
en: I will not lose your papers tomorrow.

lat: ghadi twedder s-swaret ila khrejti daba
ar: غادي توضر السوارت إيلا خرجتي دابا
en: You (m.) will lose the keys if you go out now.

lat: ma ghadish twedder l-flus f s-suq
en: You (m.) will not lose the money in the market.

lat: ghadi tweddri t-tilifun dyalek f z-za7ma
en: You (f.) will lose your phone in the crowd.

lat: ma ghadish tweddri l-beztam dyalek tmak
ar: ما غاديش توضري البزطام ديالك تماك
en: You (f.) will not lose your wallet there.

lat: huwa ghadi ywedder l-weqt f had l-khedma
ar: هو غادي يوضر الوقت فهاد الخدمة
en: He will waste time on this job.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ywedder s-sarut dyal d-dar
ar: هو ما غاديش يوضر الساروت ديال الدار
en: He will not lose the house key.

lat: hiya ghadi twedder n-ndader dyalha l-yum
ar: هي غادي توضر النظاظر ديالها اليوم
en: She will lose her glasses today.

lat: hiya ma ghadish twedder s-sak dyalha hna
ar: هي ما غاديش توضر الصاك ديالها هنا
en: She will not lose her bag here.

lat: ghadi nweddru t-triq f had l-ghaba
en: We will lose our way in this forest.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nweddru l-weqt m3ak
ar: حنا ما غاديش نوضرو الوقت معاك
en: We will not waste time with you.

lat: ntuma ghadi tweddru s-swaret f t-triq
en: You (pl.) will lose the keys on the road.

lat: ma ghadish tweddru l-flus dyalkum f s-sfer
ar: ما غاديش توضرو الفلوس ديالكم فالسفر
en: You (pl.) will not lose your money on the trip.

lat: huma ghadi yweddru l-kora f z-zenqa
en: They will lose the ball in the alley.

lat: huma ma ghadish yweddru t-triq l l-m7etta
ar: هما ما غاديش يوضرو الطريق للمحطة
en: They will not lose the way to the station.
